info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-Create Payments Payments Authorize-v1-spec
info.description: The Payment Authorization API enables businesses to securely authorize payments in real-time. This operation allows merchants to obtain approval for a payment by validating necessary transaction details, ensuring compliance and security. Common use cases include processing online orders, subscription services, and in-app purchases. This API is tailored for developers building payment solutions, providing essential integration capabilities to enhance user experiences.

post.description: This endpoint is used to authorize a payment transaction. Once the payment is authorized, it can be captured later. Ensure that all required parameters are provided in the request body for successful authorization.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to authorize a payment transaction. It includes the necessary details required to perform the authorization process securely and efficiently.

200.description: Request completed successfully with authorization details.

requestId.description: Unique identifier for the authorization request.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the transaction.

customer.description: Information about the customer making the payment.

resource.description: The resource being requested for the payment.

priority.description: The priority level of the request.

amount.description: The total amount to be processed for payment.

currency.description: The currency in which the payment is made.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates whether a notification is required upon completion.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the payment request was made.

channel.description: The channel through which the payment is being processed.

recordIndex.description: Index of the record for tracking.

CreatePaymentsPaymentsAuthorizeRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the payment authorization operation.

firstName.description: The first name of the customer.

lastName.description: The last name of the customer.

email.description: The email address of the customer.

vipCustomer.description: Indicates if the customer is a VIP member.

Customer.description: Schema representing the customer's personal information.

CreatePaymentsPaymentsAuthorizeResponse_.title: Payment Authorization Response

status.description: Indicates whether the payment authorization was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the payment authorization.

resultId.description: The ID representing the result of the authorization.

state.description: The current state of the payment authorization.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the authorization, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message with additional information about the authorization.

audit.description: Information regarding the audit of the payment authorization.

CreatePaymentsPaymentsAuthorizeResponse_.description: The response schema for a successful payment authorization.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the authorization.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the authorization was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the authorization was created by an automated system.

AuditInfo.description: Details related to the creation and management of the payment authorization.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the total processing time of the request in milliseconds. This header can help assess the performance of the API operation.
